name: National Theatre Bucharest
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: The restored National Theatre has a broad red upturned canopy over a bowed white entrance curtain, two arched side fins, rooftop auditorium/amphitheatre, tall pale fly tower and a restrained red-and-white checker facade on the annex. OSM labels the whole complex 24 m, while the theatre explicitly places the rooftop amphitheatre floor at 24 m and describes fly bars rising to 35 m. The 38.6 m fly-tower crown is therefore a documented photo-based estimate, not a surveyed published total. Auditorium, canopy, side fins and fly tower have estimated internal plans constrained to the mapped envelope; only the overall outline and bearing are mapped. Red-brim curvature, 1.4 m thickness, support profiles, checker rhythm and seating parapets are simplified original geometry. The old theatre facade / Novotel photos 3 and 4 are different structures and were rejected. Only restored post-2014 exterior references are used; no posters, sculpture group, logos or lettering. The mapped rear technical projection is retained as a low 12.5 m service mass; its height is estimated. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
